sources.title: Reviewing the Broncos top-30 visits
sources.description: Throughout the draft process, the Broncos met with many prospects in various ways and, in some cases, met with them multiple times. They met some at the All-Star games, the Combine, at Pro Days, during Zoom calls, or they had a top-30 visit with them leading up to the draft. Today, we are going to […]
